description: Agent-operated processing can improve vault quality while atrophying human knowledge-work and meta-cognitive skills.
topics: ["[[agent-cognition]]"]
source: TFT research corpus (00_inbox/heinrich/)

Core warning: “To fully automate [metadata creation] is to outsource the very cognitive process that PKM seeks to enhance.” Delegating extraction, connection-finding, and synthesis may hide shallow understanding: an empty inbox and organized vault conceal cognitive debt.

Mechanisms:
- Collector’s Fallacy variant: agent processing hides, rather than resolves, unprocessed understanding.
- Generation Effect bypass: information generated by agents benefits agent encoding, not necessarily human memory or elaboration.
- Extended Mind decoupling: external systems extend cognition only through active coupling; frictionless disengagement makes the vault adjacent rather than cognitive.

Approval-mode curation may preserve judgment, but may not provide enough generative practice. This concerns skill atrophy, distinct from [[does agent processing recover what fast capture loses]], which concerns encoding specific content. Warning sign: inability to imagine working without the agent.

Industry risk: [[vibe notetaking is the emerging industry consensus for AI-native self-organization]] normalizes “dump everything, we organize it for you,” accelerating delegation while hiding its cognitive cost.

Potential mitigation: periodic manual mode and focused, smaller-scope evaluation through [[gardening cycle implements tend prune fertilize operations]]. Deliberate non-delegation may preserve human capability, analogous to [[fresh context per task preserves quality better than chaining phases]]. Target mechanism/theory notes per [[maintenance targeting should prioritize mechanism and theory notes]].
